verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Isaac ships official, pip-installable Isaac Sim Python packages, pre-built wheels, standalone scripting for controlling robots and environments, the Isaac Lab framework (including agent skills), and production ROS 2 packages. Together these let developers build directly against first-party SDKs. missing for 10: evidence of API reference documentation depth, SDKs beyond Python/ROS 2, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Isaac Sim provides several Python namespace packages that allow you to compose an Isaac Sim app by parts using a Python package manager (for example: pip).
Python Environment Use pip or conda for Python-first workflows
Write your first standalone script to control robots and environments.
Isaac Sim is fully extensible, so developers can build custom OpenUSD-based simulators or integrate framework capabilities into existing testing and validation pipelines.
Isaac Lab ships a library of agent skills for installation, environment creation, RL training, migration, and more.
Deploy perception, localization, mapping, manipulation, teleoperation, and AI inference using production-ready ROS packages optimized for NVIDIA platforms.
